subject: I'm getting 'Internal Server Error' when I try to install set-input.zip

messages.author: 4245924341146ca2
messages.subject: I'm getting 'Internal Server Error' when I try to install set-input.zip
parts:
I'm trying to load the 'set-input' additions to Shiny (which will be extremely useful for me), but I'm getting the following response...


> devtools::install_github('shiny', 'wch', 'set-input')
Installing github repo(s) shiny/set-input from wch
Installing shiny.zip from https://github.com/wch/shiny/archive/set-input.zip
Error: server error: (500) Internal Server Error

What am I doing wrong?

messages.author: 4245924341146ca2
messages.subject: Re: I'm getting 'Internal Server Error' when I try to install set-input.zip
parts:
I tried loading the last Shiny (0.5.0) to see if the update* functions were included.  No luck.

I then retried using git_hub and got a different result than before:

> devtools::install_github('shiny', 'wch', 'set-input')
Installing github repo(s) shiny/set-input from wch
Installing shiny.zip from https://github.com/wch/shiny/archive/set-input.zip

Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : Empty reply from server

Any ideas?

messages.author: 4245924341146ca2
messages.subject: Re: I'm getting 'Internal Server Error' when I try to install set-input.zip
parts:
I had to make several tries, but I was finally successful in reload Shiny from git_hub ... and the update*() functions that I was looking for are in there.

Problem resolved, although I'm still scratching my head about the need for repeated tries at install_github()
